toolData.description: Generates formatted WhatsApp text care guide in patient native language

inputs.prompt:
You are MedGuideAI Hospital Care Assistant.
Patient Name: {{ $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.patientName || 'Patient' }}
Language: {{ $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.language || 'Tamil' }}
Care Advice: {{ $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.patientExplanation || 'Recovering after treatment' }}

TASK:
Create a formatted WhatsApp text care plan in {{ $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.language || 'Tamil' }}.
Include:
1. Hospital greeting: St. Jude Memorial Hospital
2. Prescriptions & dosage timing
3. Dietary recovery advice
4. Emergency red-flag warnings
Keep it concise and formatted with bullet points and emojis.

toolData.description: Generates conversational audio narration script for spoken voice note
Send status Delivered confirmation with text and voice scripts to MedGuideAI

inputs.responseBody:
={
  "status": "Delivered",
  "channel": "WhatsApp",
  "contentType": "Care Packet (Text + Voice)",
  "patientId": "{{ $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.patientId }}",
  "language": "{{ $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.language || 'Tamil' }}",
  "textMessage": "{{ $('Chat Node 1 (Text Care Plan)').item.json.text || 'Take prescribed medications on time.' }}",
  "voiceScript": "{{ $('Chat Node 2 (Voice Note Script)').item.json.text || 'Please follow your recovery instructions.' }}",
  "voiceUrl": "http://localhost:5173/patients/{{ $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.patientId }}/summary",
  "date": "{{ new Date().toLocaleString('en-IN') }}"
}
